hypothesis: Frozen pretrained MobileNetV3-small features with supervised balanced heads can distinguish five crop roles and the two known TeamTrack teams.
training: 400 Adam full-batch updates per head, lr .005, weight_decay .01, role inverse-frequency cross entropy
selection: Highest validation macro F1, earliest epoch on ties
scope: Conditional crop classification; source-image grouped external validation; same-match new-clip team validation. Not independent project test or full-image role mAP.
